description: This file contains a function 'preinit_set_mac_address' which sets MAC addresses for certain Zyxel board models during pre-initialization, using functions to retrieve and modify MAC addresses. It registers this function as a hook to run at the preinit_main stage.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for network interfaces eth0 and eth1 based on hardware-specific data for certain Zyxel models.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address
